title: Compare a secret buffer with a repeated byte
goal: Check a fixed-length secret against a repeated byte with FixedTimeEquals; keep timing claims local to the primitive.

selectionNotes: Fixed length is public; no timing-benchmark or protocol-wide guarantee.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Primary APIs require the .NET 11 framework contracts.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the declared .NET 11 target; the exact RC2 pin is evidence, not a minimum SDK.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical sample language mode, without preview syntax.

providers: Managed framework primitive; no native provider.
prerequisites: Console net11.0, C# 15.0, nullable/implicit usings enabled; import System.Security.Cryptography. Full functions and caller instructions are included offline.
constraints: Functional tests establish byte comparison, not a timing benchmark or constant-time surrounding protocol.
No account, resource provisioning, persistent key store, authenticated protocol, FIPS certification or unverified older-target package route is claimed.
stabilityLimitations: RC2 proof only; GA and other platforms unverified.

sources.title: Canonical RC2 support and experimental boundaries

evidence.scope: Actual original previous-release comparison on Windows x64; not an equivalent newer algorithm or a served .NET 10 recipe.
Actual Linux x64/OpenSSL 3.5.5 round trips and rejection checks in a network-disabled authoring container. See output and recipe for exact claims.

humanProof.scope: Actual primitive and local ephemeral-certificate operations are automated. Peer authentication, production trust/PKI, external interoperability, unexecuted platforms and GA are not claimed.
